definitions.ask: Should `\\` also close the tabs in Highlights' other windows?
definitions.why: matches macOS's own Close Other Tabs, and `\<` / `\>` can only mean one tab bar

choices.label: Close only the focused window's other tabs; other Highlights windows stay open
Also close every tab in Highlights' other windows, leaving only the current tab open

definitions.ask: Should a fourth key, `\u`, reopen the last batch these keys closed?
definitions.why: keeps to the three requested keys, and Open Recent already recovers a mistaken close

choices.label: Ship only the three requested keys; recover a mistaken close with Highlights' File › Open Recent
Add `\u` to reopen the last closed batch's PDFs (in memory only; a reload forgets it)
